eligibility: Own a qualifying vehicle (pickup, cargo van, box truck, or even sedan/SUV) — or join labor-only

steps: Apply as a GoShare delivery professional at goshare.co/drivers
Pass screening and list your vehicle type

biggest_catch: The headline rates are all ceilings ('up to $168/hr' for box trucks); what you actually clear depends on your market, deadhead miles, and gas — most drivers land far below the top number.
notes: Official per-vehicle rate ceilings and weekly direct deposit confirmed. Conservative task range $90-$200 reflects realistic accepted jobs, not the ceiling.

weasel_words.quote: Every rate is 'up to' — ceilings, not typical earnings. Verified conservatively below the ceiling.

repeatable.cadence: See a project's pay before you accept it, complete the move or delivery, and get paid in the weekly direct deposit — repeat for every project you take.

maximize: Start with the vehicle you already own — even a sedan pays up to $45/hr for courier work; accept jobs that minimize empty return miles since deadhead is unpaid; run weekend and month-end jobs when moving demand spikes; track every mile for the tax deduction; price a commercial/delivery insurance endorsement before your first gig, not after a claim.
who_pays: GoShare pays you by weekly direct deposit. Customers book and pay through the platform; GoShare runs the billing (via its payment processor Routable) and routes your pay to you.
who_qualifies: You need a qualifying vehicle — pickup, cargo van, box truck, or even a sedan/SUV — or you can join as labor-only with no vehicle at all. Everyone needs a valid driver's license, insurance, a passed background check, the ability to lift heavy items, and to be in a GoShare-served market.
work_available: Projects are offered in the app and you compete with other delivery pros for them; volume and pay vary sharply by your market and your vehicle type — bigger vehicles get higher-paying jobs, but far fewer of them.
what_gets_accepted: You get paid for projects you complete as scheduled. Customers rate you, and dropping below a 4.0 average rating, no-showing, or three cancellations in 30 days can get your account suspended or permanently deactivated, per GoShare's own driver policies. No-shows also carry a $50 fee; cancellations cost $20 (1–48 hours before start) or $30 (under 1 hour).
costs_and_unpaid_time: No upfront fee. You cover gas, maintenance, and vehicle wear — and your personal auto policy usually excludes commercial delivery, so you may need an insurance endorsement. GoShare can also fine you up to $50 for cancellations and $50 for no-shows, charged to your card or deducted from earnings. Unpaid time: the application process, waiting for projects, and driving empty to pickups (deadhead miles).
when_cash_arrives: Weekly direct deposits from GoShare — not same-day money.
